name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
description: A defender of Thraben who will not see it fall to the unhallowed horde.

description_citations.text: Masters 25: card flavor text (Masters 25, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia founds the Order of Saint Traft against the Lunarch Council's corruption.
timeline.quote: Thalia established the Order of Saint Traft in an effort to bring together cathars who would stand against the corruption of the Lunarch Council.

citation.text: Tenacity (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Thalia vows not to see Thraben fall to the unhallowed horde.
timeline.quote: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

citation.text: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (Masters 25, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
